# 上方大洞真元陰陽陟降圖書後解

**ID:** KR5b0122
**Custom ID:** ZB5b0122

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A thirteen-folio Southern-Sòng Daoist text transmitted in the *Dàozàng* in a composite *juàn* with DZ 439 ([KR5b0123](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0123)). In reality, DZ 437 ([KR5b0121](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0121)) and the present DZ 438 form a single work divided by the Míng editors.

**Abstract**

Dated to the Southern Sòng by Yuán Bǐnglíng (Schipper & Verellen, *Taoist Canon* 3: 1221, DZ 438). See [KR5b0121](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0121) for the combined context: together with DZ 437, this work provides the complete set of twelve cosmological diagrams of the *Zhēnyuán* 真元 corpus. The present half contains the latter seven diagrams (the first five being in DZ 437). The first drawing here illustrates the phases of *yīn* and *yáng*, and hence *huǒhòu* 火候 ("fire-phasing") in alchemy. The text again cites the *Jīndān gē* 金丹歌 of Gāo Xiàngxiān 高象先 (fl. 990–1013; cf. DZ 1079 *Zhēnrén Gāo Xiàngxiān jīndān gē*), and the Táng emperor Xuánzōng ("Mínghuáng") is mentioned at 10b.

The work is a principal witness to the cross-pollination of *nèidān* 內丹 thought, Daoist cosmological diagrammatism, and the Xuánwǔ 玄武 / Wǔdāng 武當 cult in the twelfth-century Daoist synthesis.
